title: Pricing model: the reference product's Black 76 against ours with an implied dividend yield (G-13-4)
reference_behaviour: Greeks come from a modified Black 76 model in which theta, vega and gamma are the same for a call and a put (bundle-findings 2.5 and 7.1).
ours: Black-Scholes-Merton with each expiry's implied dividend yield; call and put theta differ by a carry term (a few rupees per day, unmeasured). Decided by ADR-063.
